approach: Find the common acceleration of the whole three-part system, then apply Newton's second law to each end block to get the tension at each end of the string.

steps.text: Find the acceleration of the whole system: the two blocks plus the string.
Apply Newton's second law to the 2 kg block alone; only the tension at A pulls it.
Apply Newton's second law to the 1 kg block alone; F pulls it forward and the tension at B pulls it back.

common_mistakes.text: Treating the string as massless makes the tension equal at both ends, giving a = 8/3 m/s² and one tension of 5.33 N instead of the two different values 4 N and 6 N.
